reviews.text: Extremely kind, knowledgeable, and professional! The cat was pampered and happy. Highly recommended! Thank you, Milena and Diego!
We thank Diego for the sweetness and professionalism with which he kept our two dachshunds, Wilma and Don Diego, happy to visit the Vatican Museums.
Competence and punctuality, and we immediately became friends with Nino

I wanted to thank Milena and Diego for taking care of my two cats for a week. Every time they visited the kittens, they fed them, cleaned their litter box, and played with them. They sent me lots of photos and videos of their time together. They are affectionate, reliable, and serious people. I highly recommend contacting them if you need help. Thank you for everything, and see you next time!

Fantastic people 😍
They created a group where they updated us with videos and photos every time they arrived from our Luna!
Luna was fine, never showed any signs of distress and always ate and played.
We definitely recommend them; after this first experience, we'll rely on them for Luna whenever we need them.
Top service, always punctual and precise. Highly recommended!

Diego and Milena regularly take care of my cat Lupetta when I'm away from Rome, even for extended periods, and I've always been very happy with them. They've proven to be consistently reliable and attentive, providing me with regular updates accompanied by photos and videos that have given me peace of mind. The service is meticulous and professional. Highly recommended.
I love them and my Muffin adores them. They've become friends now and we're super happy. Sweetness and professionalism.

Extremely reliable, attentive, precise, and highly professional people who do their job with love. They're attentive to all our animals' needs. When I have to leave early, I ask them if they're available, and that says it all!
Wonderful, affectionate with cats, honest, and punctual! Always available to help with solutions. A truly valuable asset!

I can only share my very positive experience with Milena and Diego, two true professionals as well as animal lovers, and that makes all the difference in the world! Our cat is so happy to play with them; I remember that even after a day, he didn't even let her have a tummy time! When I leave him at home and know they're taking care of him, I feel at ease and know he's in good hands.
Highly recommended!
Milena was my pet sitter for a while. Unfortunately, I moved and lost her invaluable service. She was unparalleled. My cat adored her, and I felt so at ease with her.

We met Milena thanks to a consultation for Kaori, our cat who peed on the couch. With her precious advice and support, the episodes have practically disappeared (the "almost" is just for superstition). Later, we also met Diego, and from there, it was natural to trust them both with catsitting. When we're away, the only real peace of mind is knowing that Matisse and Kaori are in good hands with Milena and Diego. Matisse is a bit shy, and Kaori is a shadow, shy, distrustful, and unapproachable... yet, with skill, patience, and a great deal of respect for time, they managed to win them both over.
Milena and Diego are not your typical cat sitters; they observe, understand, and truly care for the cats. They are precious but, above all, reliable presences that make the difference.

Milena and Diego cared for our two cats, Carolina and Amelia, with great care and passion. They kept us updated every day with photos and videos of the kittens, as well as playing with them. I highly recommend them for their professionalism and love for animals.
